comment_regular: Seeds the embedded light-list cursor from property +0x70 and returns the first usable ShadowSceneLight. Oblivion rejects frustumCull == 0xFF, backing-light AppCulled, and light byte +0xF4 == 1. Fallout was consulted afterward only for the conventional GetFirstActiveLight label; its later implementation lacks Oblivion's +0xF4 rejection.
